subject: ইংরেজি
question:
For each of the following advanced vocabulary words, provide: (1) its precise definition, (2) an exact antonym, and (3) an administrative or technical sentence:
(a) Tenacious
(b) Impeccable
(c) Superfluous
(d) Vulnerable
(e) Exemplary
(f) Dichotomy
answer:
High-Impact Vocabulary Analysis:

(a) **Tenacious** (Adjective):
• Definition: Tending to keep a firm hold of something; persistent and determined.
• Antonym: Irresolute / Weak / Yielding.
• *Sentence:* The forensic engineer's tenacious investigation eventually pinpointed the stealthy backdoor script buried deep within the application logs.

(b) **Impeccable** (Adjective):
• Definition: In accordance with the highest standards; faultless and spotless.
• Antonym: Flawed / Defective / Blemished.
• *Sentence:* The data center maintained an impeccable track record of 99.999% uptime throughout the entire fiscal year.

(c) **Superfluous** (Adjective):
• Definition: Unnecessary, especially through being more than enough; redundant.
• Antonym: Essential / Indispensable / Necessary.
• *Sentence:* Upgrading the network switch firmware rendered several legacy diagnostic scripts completely superfluous.

(d) **Vulnerable** (Adjective):
• Definition: Susceptible to physical or emotional attack or damage.
• Antonym: Invulnerable / Resilient / Immune.
• *Sentence:* Unpatched operating systems leave critical passport enrollment workstations vulnerable to automated ransomware worms.

(e) **Exemplary** (Adjective):
• Definition: Serving as a desirable model; representing the best of its kind.
• Antonym: Reprehensible / Substandard / Deplorable.
• *Sentence:* The Sub-Assistant Maintenance Engineer received an official commendation for his exemplary leadership during the data center power crisis.

(f) **Dichotomy** (Noun):
• Definition: A division or contrast between two things that are represented as being entirely opposed or different.
• Antonym: Harmony / Unity / Uniformity.
• *Sentence:* Modern border security must bridge the dichotomy between impenetrable national defense and smooth, expedited passenger transit.
points_to_remember: Precise definitions and relevant technical sentences show deep vocabulary mastery.
